mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are seeing 52 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park and a waning crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community feedback, focuses on housing, economic growth, and downtown revitalization over the coming decades.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday Nights, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 28, police responded to a crash where a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly was cited for multiple violations after colliding with an SUV.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's of Verona is Double Strawberry. The restaurant will open today at 10:00 AM.
